messages:
oliver_ng: Hey team - onboarding snag. I clicked the org invite and GitHub asked me to 'Claim account' and showed two emails (oliver@work.co and oliver.personal@gmail.com). I picked the work one but it errored 'email already in use'. Anyone seen this?
onboarding-bot: Welcome @oliver_ng! Usually this means that email is associated with an existing GitHub account (maybe as a secondary). Ping @it-support with the email and we can check org invites.
oliver_ng: I don't have that work email listed on my personal GH (I think). Also when I accept it tried to prompt for SSO but then failed.
it-support: Hi Oliver - can you DM the exact work email? Also is your personal GH account using 2FA? Sometimes GitHub will attach an invite to a personal account if an email alias matches.
oliver_ng: DM sent. Personal GH has 2FA via Authy. Work email is oliver@work.co.
tara: FWIW I hit this once: my company email was a secondary on my old account. GitHub's claim/transfer UI is confusing. We usually either (1) remove the email from the other account, or (2) we reissue an SSO-provisioned invite so it forces SSO sign-in.
it-support: Confirmed from org admin console: there's a pending invite to oliver@work.co but GitHub marked that email as linked to another account. I cleared the pending invite and created a new SSO-required invite. Try the new link and make sure to sign in via SSO when prompted.
oliver_ng: Opened the new link in an incognito window. It redirected me to our SSO, I logged in, and now I can see the org but only a subset of repos. Is that expected?
it-support: After SSO accept we'll map you to default engineering groups. Specific repo access depends on team mappings. @devops-bot will add default teams; if you need infra or deploy rights ping @tara.
devops-bot: Automated: added oliver_ng to team engineering-default. If you need repo-level write rights, request in #eng-infra or DM @tara.
emma_h: Welcome @oliver_ng! If you still see any repos missing, check your org teams page or ask for the repo name. Also double-check your Git remotes if you run into 403s (cached creds can cause odd failures).
oliver_ng: Thanks all - SSO flow fixed the claim error and I'm in. I requested access to infra and CI repos via DM to @tara. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
